map.快消品仓月度盘点：统计周期取 90 天、呆滞阈值取 180 天，按「名称,库存量: Monthly stocktake at a fast-moving consumer goods warehouse: take a 90-day statistics period and a 180-day dead stock threshold, paste the inventory details line by line as name, stock quantity, outbound quantity, inventory age in days, unit price, and the tool works out the average daily outbound quantity, turnover days and inventory value of each SKU, and gives the dead stock value share.
map.呆滞品排序与处置：结果按周转天数降序排列，周转天数大于阈值即判定呆滞；日均出库为: Ranking and handling dead stock: results are sorted by turnover days in descending order, and any SKU above the threshold is judged dead stock; when average daily outbound quantity is 0, turnover days is recorded as ∞ and the SKU is judged dead stock directly. When dead capital is concentrated, give priority to promotions to clear stock, markdowns, or returns to the supplier, and check the inventory value of each SKU in the detail table.
map.阈值与周期口径复核：统计周期可选 30/90/180 天，周期直接决定日均出库大: Reviewing the threshold and period: the statistics period can be 30 / 90 / 180 days, and the period directly determines the size of the average daily outbound quantity, so it should match the basis used by finance or the ERP. Set the dead stock threshold by category (fast-moving goods 90 days, home appliances 180 days, spare parts 365 days); changing the threshold can completely change the conclusion on the same data, so keep a snapshot of the inputs.
map.算例：3 个 SKU 的呆滞筛查（周期 90 天 / 阈值 180 天）: Worked example: dead stock screening for 3 SKUs (90-day period / 180-day threshold)
map.输入：矿泉水,5000,12000,30,2.5；纸巾,2000,3000,45: Input: mineral water,5000,12000,30,2.5; tissues,2000,3000,45,5; old-model cookware,800,50,220,80. Calculation: average daily outbound = outbound quantity ÷ 90 → mineral water 133.33 units/day, tissues 33.33 units/day, old-model cookware 0.56 units/day; turnover days = stock quantity ÷ average daily outbound → 37.5 days, 60.0 days, 1440.0 days; inventory value = stock quantity × unit price → 12,500 CNY, 10,000 CNY, 64,000 CNY. Determination: only old-model cookware, with turnover days of 1440 > 180, is judged dead stock. Summary: 3 SKUs in total, 1 dead stock item, total inventory value 86,500 CNY, dead stock value 64,000 CNY, dead stock share 74.0% — which means inventory capital is heavily tied up in a single dead item, so clearing the old-model cookware should come first.
map.统计周期该选多少天？换周期会不会改变结论？: How many days should the statistics period be? Would changing the period change the conclusion?
map.周期必须与财务或 ERP 的出库统计口径一致，常用 90 天（一个季度）。周期越: The period must match the outbound statistics basis of finance or the ERP, and 90 days (one quarter) is common. A longer period smooths the average daily outbound quantity, while a short period is easily distorted by promotions or stockouts. On the same data, the average daily outbound quantity can differ by a factor of 6 between a 30-day and a 180-day period, and turnover days and the dead stock judgement change with it, so record the period and threshold for every analysis to allow comparison across periods.
map.周转天数显示 ∞ 是什么意思，怎么处理？: What does it mean when turnover days shows ∞, and how should it be handled?
map.表示该 SKU 在统计周期内出库量为 0，日均出库为 0，工具按无穷大处理并直接: It means the SKU had zero outbound quantity in the statistics period, so the average daily outbound quantity is 0; the tool treats it as infinity and judges it dead stock directly. First check whether the item is genuinely discontinued or unsellable, or whether the outbound data has not been synced or the basis is incomplete; once confirmed, put it on the list to be cleared, to avoid treating missing data as dead stock and disposing of it by mistake.
